The earlier schedule is correct. I re-derived it from the constraints and it is the only valid arrangement.

- Ben must come after Finn, Hana, Gus and Ivo, which are four distinct people, so Ben is in slot 5 or later.
- Ann is directly after Ben (slot B+1), and "exactly one person between Ann and Elif" with Ann before Cara forces Cara = B+2 and Elif = B+3.
- Dev must be after Elif, so Dev is at least B+4. That leaves room for Dev only if B ≤ 5, so Ben is in slot 5, Ann 6, Cara 7, Elif 8, Dev 9.
- Slots 1–4 hold Finn, Ivo, Hana and Gus. Hana ≤ 3 from the Ann–Hana gap of 3, and Finn and Gus must be 3 apart, so {Finn, Gus} is {1, 4}. Gus cannot be 1 because Ivo must come before him, so Finn is 1 and Gus is 4. That forces Ivo 2 and Hana 3.

I checked all 17 constraints against this schedule and each one holds.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ivo","3":"Hana","4":"Gus","5":"Ben","6":"Ann","7":"Cara","8":"Elif","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
